name: get_asset_record
description: get_asset_record: Look up a specific asset by its asset tag. Returns the device type, model, serial number, status, warranty information, and which employee it is assigned to.

asset_tag.description: The asset tag, in the format AST followed by a dash, 3 uppercase letters, a dash, and 6 digits (e.g. AST-LPT-284719).
